dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature on the trailing edge forming a parabolic arc from the apex to the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Broadly rounded morphological peak with a high pixel radius; non-acute.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree posterior incline relative to the dorsal longitudinal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Horizontal base chord length is approximately 1.6 times the maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex semicircular arc defining the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a visible length approximately 0.8 times its basal thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse transition angle of approximately 135 degrees where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan monochromatic luminescence across the entire visible epidermal surface.
